authority: R-IV.1303(b). The card's COST LINE lives here and nowhere else. The stamped rules file (regime_rules.v2.1.json, LF sha256 4bc6d895...) is a CLASSIFICATION artifact and stays byte-identical, so its own `hysteresis.stated_cost` is NOT displayed and must not be read for display.
why_a_separate_file: A sentence about what a classifier gets wrong is a DISPLAY fact that changes when someone grades the classifier; the thresholds it describes are a CLASSIFICATION fact that must not change at all. Holding both in one file meant the only way to correct the sentence was to edit an immutable artifact -- which is the collision R-IV.1297(e) hit and R-IV.1303(b) resolves.

cost_lines.v2.1: SPY 1999-2026, 24 declines: all-clear a median 81.5 sessions after the low, never on 11; 200d line 38. (R-IV.1301)

absent_means: A rules_version with no entry in `cost_lines` shows NO cost line on the card -- not a blank heading, and never a line borrowed from another version. v2 has no entry because the line was graded and supplied for v2.1 (R-IV.1301(c)).
not_mine_to_write: R-IV.925(b). A cost line is a claim about measured behaviour. BUILD does not author one; it serves what QUERY grades. v2.1's line is QUERY's under R-IV.1301 and is copied verbatim; v2's absence is deliberate, not pending.
cost_lines_source: R-IV.1307(b), verbatim. QUERY's grade of the hysteresis under R-IV.1301; the underlying measurement is R-IV.1280 / R-IV.1273(b) (REGIME-SCORECARD v1, SPY only, labels 1999-01-04 to 2026-10-16). Copied character for character and not paraphrased: a cost line is a claim about measured behaviour, and BUILD does not author one (R-IV.925(b)).
